items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I finally got Marie to come over, and Marie's a nurse, so I could get to the doctor.

ctx.x: So after we hung up that night later on my wife called the house here, where my mother and her mother was living right here, and her mother'd gone to bed, and she talked to my mother, and said, 'Grandma,' said, 'Let me talk to mother.' She's asleep. Well, tell her to be ready at 9:00. I'm going to take her to the hairdresser and get her hair done, and we're going to Beaumont. Joe Thomas Formoth's coming in.' Blah, blah, blah, and just like that -- okay.

Nurse across the street, Marie -- she's a German girl and her husband worked at Borden and all, Borden Milk Company, and normally Rogers is a critical guy, but he sat over here this night, and Marie was teaching my wife how to crochet with needles and things, whatever, and we're looking at a movie, Roger and I together, and finally they sat and sat

and sat until about quarter to 11:00, and Roger said, "I'm hungry." Oh, Elizabeth said, "Oh, man, you can eat anytime." "No," he said, "I'm staying over here since 7:00 something." He said, "I'm hungry now." So they left and went home.
